$comment: Declarative editorial input of `jjv editorial build-config`. Paths are relative to the episode root. Cross-field rules (both-shots forbidden under mismatch/unknown continuity, tail handles, coverage) are enforced by engine/editorial, not by this schema.

frame.description: Optional: the start of to_shot on the timeline. When written it must equal it.

type.description: A transition PRESET name from schemas/transition-presets.json (the one source of truth: category, frames rule, params, direction, tail, shows_both, safe_for). This enum is generated from the catalog's ready presets (a test asserts equality); a planned preset is refused with its own message. 'none' = pixel-continuous carry, 'cut' = designed hard cut. `dip_white` with frames 9 is the legacy schedule (preset dip_white_legacy, build warning).

frames.description: Optional: omitted = the preset default; written = must satisfy the preset's frames rule (fixed | min/max/even).

direction.description: Optional (0 when omitted); required to be -1 or +1 by presets whose direction rule is 'required'.

tail_clip.description: Native clip of the outgoing shot, inside the episode root (or allow-listed).

params.description: Preset params; unknown, out-of-range or mistyped ones are refused, defaults are filled.

framing.description: Optional. same_framing (same seat/angle) + a visible preset gives a build warning (use cut or cut_push).

start_frame.description: Required unless ending.derive_timeline (then derived from the card WAVs).

duration_frames.description: Required unless ending.derive_timeline (then max(card_min_frames, ceil(wav_seconds x fps))).

max_rms.description: Largest RMS (full scale) the EXPORT may have in the window; 0 < max_rms <= 0.05 (-26 dBFS). The ceiling is the engine constant engine/qa/av.py SILENT_MAX_RMS_CEILING and is justified by measurement on ep04: its quietest dialogue WAV has RMS 0.0731 and the silent-window bed measures 0.0279 (v010, S06_B3). Choose bed-relative: the measured bed times sqrt(2) (a line as loud as the bed raises the window by 3 dB), never above the ceiling. A larger value is refused.

silent_bound.description: The expect_silent window as written into a review config's wav_bindings (silent_window without the shot name); qa av validates it with this definition.

max_rms.description: Largest RMS (full scale) the EXPORT may have in the window; 0 < max_rms <= 0.05 (-26 dBFS). The ceiling is the engine constant engine/qa/av.py SILENT_MAX_RMS_CEILING and is justified by measurement on ep04: its quietest dialogue WAV has RMS 0.0731 and the silent-window bed measures 0.0279 (v010, S06_B3). Choose bed-relative: the measured bed times sqrt(2) (a line as loud as the bed raises the window by 3 dB), never above the ceiling. A larger value is refused.

ending.$comment: Render parameters of the ending, passed through to the config. end_logo.frames/from_frame/total_frames are DERIVED from the episode timeline (end_card_frames) and may not be declared here. derive_timeline: card lengths come from the card WAVs, card 1 starts logo_hold_frames after the dialogue end, the end plate follows the last card window (end_plate.placement), main_frames = plate start + frames_after_card_window, the end card (EndLogo) is end_card_frames, and the logo disc layout / iris window follow the outro start (editorial property only; the domain master contract is unchanged, a longer result only warns).

start.description: Required unless ending.derive_timeline; when written it must equal the placement rule (card_end: the end of the last card window; speech_end: ceil of the measured speech end).

placement.description: Where the end plate starts. speech_end (default without derive_timeline): ceil of the measured end of the last card word, inside the last card window. card_end (default with derive_timeline): the first frame after the last card window; never before the measured speech end.

frames_after_card_window.description: card_end only: plate frames kept inside the main film after the last card window (default 4); the end card follows.

logo_hold_frames.description: Schema sanity only (a positive integer); the floor is the domain delivery.sections.logo_hold.min, enforced by engine/editorial/end_card.check_params. derive_timeline: the still logo hold in frames between the dialogue end and card 1 (card 1 starts at dialogue end + logo_hold_frames). Default 60.

end_card_frames.description: Schema sanity only; the floor is the domain delivery.end_card.frames_min (end_card.check_params). derive_timeline: length of the end card (EndLogo) after the main film. Default: the episode timeline end_card_frames.

card_min_frames.description: Schema sanity only; the floor is the domain delivery.sections.vocab_card.min (end_card.check_params).

logo_disc_layout.description: Numeric layout of the logo disc (slide_start, slide_end, slide_x, pill_left_x, disc_in, ...), passed through as data.

music_bed.description: Music bed policy for a derived (longer) timeline, validated and passed through.

expect_silent.description: One entry per physical shot whose bound WAV is silent. The window must equal the shot's window; qa av then checks that the EXPORT stays at or below max_rms (RMS, full scale) there and reports the measured bed level. A silent WAV without an entry, an entry for an audible WAV, max_rms above 0.05, or words timed inside the window are refused.
